full_inspection: Compared all four native images line by line, including the title, author line, complete body, every margin and the small mark over travail. No other differing textual locus or handwritten mark was found.
original_transcription_comparison: Compared the complete original transcriptions with each other and with both scans; all prose strings agree. The title/author deletion macros and archive foliation are the only substantive original transcription differences.

entries.decision: retain the copy2 title deletion; retain the live copy1 title
entries.reason: Long oblique pen strokes cross the title block in copy2; copy1 has no crossing strokes.

entries.decision: retain the copy2 author-line deletion; retain the live copy1 author line
entries.reason: The same oblique pen strokes cross the author line in copy2; copy1 remains uncrossed.

entries.decision: retain both distinct archive foliations without assigning an author
entries.reason: Both numerals are handwritten. Copy1 reads 3; copy2 reads 79 with a closed upper loop in the last digit.
